other_conditions: Mother or guardian must be a resident of Andhra Pradesh
Child must be studying in Class 1 to Class 12
School/college must be a recognized Government, Private Aided, Private Unaided school or Junior College, or Residential School/Junior College in Andhra Pradesh
Scheme is applicable from the Academic Year 2019-20
Total family income must be less than ₹10,000 per month in Rural Areas and less than ₹12,000 per month in Urban Areas (BPL)
No family member may be a Government employee or Government pensioner, except families of sanitary workers
Family must not own a four‑wheeler, except for Taxis, Tractors, and Autos
Monthly electricity consumption of the family dwelling unit must be below 300 units (six‑month average)
No family member should be an income‑tax payee
Land under the municipal area must be less than 1000 sq ft
Child’s attendance must be at least 75%
benefits_summary: ₹14,000 per year is deposited directly into the mother/guardian’s savings account, with ₹1,000 deducted at source for the District Toilet Maintenance Fund.
